title: feat(console): a marketplace app's Install confirms what it adds before it installs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDxCGUhEdUjr6paznZqQ5b6)_
domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwKGwfa8bd6GQV8vHC

Fixes #30325
Supersedes #30545 (same reviewed diff, resumed from `claude/project-thread-o1qmt2@816df8503f` on this thread's own branch; its strings now live in the lazy `marketplace` namespace).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：市场应用详情页点「安装」（装进本运行时）不再立刻开装，先弹控制台自己的确认框，写明会加入几个对象、几个权限集、几条示例记录，以及装后会建议把哪个权限集授予所有已登录用户；确认框里再点「安装」照原样安装，「取消」什么都不装。示例数据仍默认加载。行为与 #30545 已过席位复核的版本完全相同。
- 为什么改：#30325 实测：HotCRM 一点安装就直接 处理中…，一次加了几十个对象、权限集和 369 条示例记录，管理员事先看不到。#30545 当时被首屏英文语言包的体积上限挡住；#30640 把市场文案搬进按需加载的 `marketplace` 文案包后，本 PR 把确认框的 11 条文案也放进那里，首屏语言包一个字节都不增加。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端；数字取自页面原本就在读的同一份版本 manifest（install-local 实际安装的也是它），不新增请求；读不到 manifest 时确认框如实说读不到，安装照常可用。首屏 `i18n-locale-en` 57,003 / 60,000 gz，与 main 相同，上限未动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/installPreview.ts`（计数口径）、`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 的 `doInstallLocal` / `runInstallLocal` 与新 `AlertDialog`、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/en.ts` 的 `install.preview` 段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/installPreview-30325.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：ui 席 2 对照 head `5d7d5c34` 复核：确认框行为与 #30545 已复核版本相同，计数只读页面原有的同一份 manifest，不新增请求；11 条文案进按需加载的 `marketplace` 文案包，首屏英文包 57,003 / 60,000 gz、上限未动。`marketplaceApi.ts` 与 `installPreview.ts` 不在 `@object-ui/app-shell` 入口导出，`marketplace` 命名空间只导出无键类型的目录，故 Clause-② no 成立，不欠契约复审。同意落地。

## What changes

The behaviour is the one PR #30545 carried and the seat reviewed on its diff; this PR resumes that branch at `816df8503f`, merges `origin/main` (which now holds PR #30640, the lazy `marketplace` namespace), and moves the confirm's strings into that namespace. Nothing else in the reviewed diff changed.

- **The confirm.** The package page's local Install (`doInstallLocal`) now opens an `AlertDialog` instead of posting at once. It names the package, then lists **Objects / Permission sets / Sample records** as label and number, a note that sample records load with the app and can be cleared from this page afterwards, and one line per permission set the install will suggest granting to Everyone (nothing is granted until an administrator accepts). Its **Install** calls `runInstallLocal`, the unchanged install body (modes, result notes, refusals all as before); **Cancel** installs nothing. Reinstall gets the same confirm with a reinstall title.
- **Where the counts come from** (`installPreview.ts`, a pure reader). The page already read `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages/ID/versions/latest/manifest` for `installModes`; that body is what install-local fetches and installs. `marketplaceApi.ts` exposes the body read (`getServedPackageBody`) and the mode reader as a pure function (`declaredInstallModesOf`), and the page derives both the modes and the preview from the ONE read. Objects (list or name-keyed map), permission sets (only a LIST of named sets), sample records (top-level `data[]` seed datasets, "up to N" when a dataset is env- or locale-scoped), suggested grants (sets declaring `isDefault: true`, ADR-0090 D5), across every package body the artifact carries.
- **Sample-record count, read one way with #30323.** Before install: the declared seed records above. After install: `sampleRecordsLoaded` reads the install answer's `seeded`.
- **Unreadable manifest.** The confirm says what the package adds could not be read and the install result will say what loaded; its Install still installs.
- **Strings, now lazy.** `marketplace.install.preview.*` (11 keys) sit in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/LANG.ts` for all ten languages, inside each catalogue's `install` group right after `unmanagedIgnored`, text byte-identical to #30545's. The eager packs (`src/locales/LANG.ts`) are exactly `origin/main`'s. Studio's packages page does not read these keys (the confirm is drawn only by `MarketplacePackagePage`, which renders under `MarketplaceNamespaceGate`), so none belongs in the resident set; `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` holds that. `atMost` stays on the count-neutral list of `count-families-11445.test.ts`.
- **Merge.** The only hand resolution in `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` is the import block: main's multi-line `sampleDataNotice.js` import kept, the `installPreview.js` import added above it.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30325-install-confirm-what-it-adds.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch; its Strings line now names the namespace.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-7yy8nl`, not `claude/issue-30325-*`; the card is #30325 (claim 6677784267).

## Tests

- `MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx` (6 cases, real `marketplaceApi` over a stubbed `fetch`) and `installPreview-30325.test.ts` (6 cases), as in #30545, now resolving their strings through the namespace frame.
- Existing local-install tests click the confirm after Install (`credentialStep-27238`, `dependencyMissing-25792`, `installMode-12288`, `protocolCheckSkipped-30326`, `sampleDataNotice-30323`, `servedTruth-12098`, `walledCatalogPackageRefusal-7611`). No assertion changed. The whole `console/marketplace/` directory, including the tests main added since #30545's base, passes on this head.
- The positive control was #30545's (page restored to its base with the new tests kept: 6 failed / 6); the page source is unchanged here apart from the import merge, so it was not re-run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Eager budget, no ceiling raise.** Console `CI=true vite build` on `ff5d4116cf`: `i18n-locale-en` reads 57,003 gzip bytes against the 60,000 ceiling (headroom 2,997), the same reading #30640 recorded for main; `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` untouched. The confirm's strings ship in the lazy `i18n-ns-marketplace-LANG` chunks (the `en` one contains "Reading what this package adds"; the eager `i18n-locale-en` chunk does not).
- **Live measurement.** Not re-run on this head; #30545's live run (real showcase stack with a stand-in control plane: the confirm read 3 / 2 / 13 and the install answer seeded 13) covers the unchanged behaviour. The string move is covered by the namespace frame tests, which render the page through the lazy catalogue.
- Same class, not in this PR (from #30545, carried to the seat there): the catalog page's organization-package Install (`MarketplacePage.tsx` `doOrgInstall`) also posts install-local on one click with no confirm (read in code, not run).

## Verification

All on head `5d7d5c349a` unless noted (`ff5d4116cf` differs from it only in the changeset text).
